units.text: The context output format shows several lines of context around the lines that differ. It is the standard format for distributing updates to source code.
units.sourceHTML: The context output format shows several lines of context around the lines that differ. It is the standard format for distributing updates to source code.

units.text: To select this output format, use the ⟦0⟧ (⟦1⟧) or ⟦2⟧ option. The argument ⟦3⟧ that some of these options take is the number of lines of context to show. If you do not specify ⟦4⟧, it defaults to three. For proper operation, ⟦5⟧ typically needs at least two lines of context.
units.sourceHTML: To select this output format, use the --context[=lines] (-C lines) or -c option. The argument lines that some of these options take is the number of lines of context to show. If you do not specify lines, it defaults to three. For proper operation, patch typically needs at least two lines of context.

nonProse: Command/flag literals and pure code/output examples retained; explanatory dt labels and italic pre descriptions extracted too; no unhandled prose text.
